summary:
I verified the builder's patch and found it correct. It is ready to publish and to test on hardware. I made three fixes to apply.py and added 11 tests. The output did not change: missionpack/zz-fleetres-menus.pk3, 28914 bytes, md5 627013444d74562c7ed28ed9caa895f2. It rebuilds byte-identical from the staged missionpack/pak0.pk3, which I re-hashed in full (e8ba9e3bf06210930bc0e7fdbcdd01c2).

What the pk3 does (unchanged from the builder). It holds edited copies of ui/system.menu (main menu > Setup > System) and ui/ingame_system.menu (ESC > System), each with three changes:
- The Video Mode list gains "Native" -1 as its first entry. At r_mode -1 the label now reads "Native" instead of being blank, and one click no longer jumps to 400x300.
- Three text items next to the control show r_customwidth, a separator and r_customheight, only while r_mode is -1. The size comes from the box's own cvars, so it is right on every monitor.
- The Quality control is removed, because its presets set r_mode 4 or 3.

What I checked myself, not from the builder's code:
- Every pinned offset and md5 (list anchors at 2877 and 4131, Quality blocks, Video Mode block ends) matches bytes I extracted with unzip. A plain line diff shows exactly three edits per file and nothing else.
- In the staged 1.32 ui.qvm bytecode: a text item with a cvar and no text paints the cvar's value (the mechanism the size display relies on), and the Quality presets really do write r_mode 4.0 or 3.0. ioquake3's own uix86.dll behaves the same.
- Drawn with the real font pages at 1920x1080, the rows read "Native 1920 *1080" in the main menu and "Native 1920 x 1080" in game. Nothing overlaps or crosses the menu frame.
- `--publish` calls sharewrite.py correctly. The q3ta-server path and sv_pure 0 are confirmed. Multiplayer is safe: .menu files never make a pk3 "referenced", so no client is kicked or made to download it.
- Nothing is on the share or on the server.

What I changed:
- `--publish` now refuses to run if the share is not visible through /mnt. Before, an absent mount read as "no file there", so the backup was skipped and the put overwrote blind.
- `--publish` also refuses if the staged original no longer builds the manifest's files. It finds the share copy case-insensitively, and a dry run no longer prints "published."
- The pk3 load-order model now upper-cases names like the engine does. It had "_" sorting the wrong way against letters.
- 11 new tests cover publish (against a fake share) and install-server.
- launcher_changes_needed is rewritten. No launcher change is required. The one future item (withdrawing the pk3) now points at the generator, stage-fleetres.py, with an exact repair pair. The unneeded vm_ui suggestion is dropped.
- The hardware plan is corrected for .195: the F11 screenshot bind does not fire while a menu is open.
launcher_changes_needed: NONE REQUIRED. The pk3 needs nothing from any launcher or from GAMERES. Play Team Arena.bat is generated by scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py (TITLES["Quake3-TeamArena"], built by q3("missionpack", ...)). It already starts the game with +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H%, and writes the same values to missionpack\fleetres.cfg. GAMERES writes that file as well (agent/shared/gameres.h:686, GR_OP_CFG "missionpack\\fleetres.cfg"). The fix adds no line to any cfg, so it cannot start a FLEETRES-vs-GAMERES fight. Nothing it generates contains a parenthesis.

INVARIANT, no change needed. For the owners of stage-fleetres.py, gameres.h and FLEETRES.EXE: keep writing r_customwidth and r_customheight as bare decimal integers ("1920", never "1920.0"), and r_mode as -1. The menus print the cvar string verbatim, and they show the size only when r_mode reads "-1" or "-1.000000".

WITHDRAWAL ONLY, not needed now. GAMESYNC never deletes, so if the pk3 is ever withdrawn the launcher must delete it. Add one repair pair to TITLES["Quake3-TeamArena"]["fix"]["Play Team Arena.bat"] in scripts/fleet/stage-fleetres.py, appended after the _REFRESH merge loop (line 1581).
- OLD = the line `call "%~dp0FLEETGL.BAT" "%~dp0missionpack\fleetres.cfg"` + CRLF + CRLF + `cd /d "%~dp0"` + CRLF.
- NEW = the same text with `if exist "%~dp0missionpack\zz-fleetres-menus.pk3" del /f /q "%~dp0missionpack\zz-fleetres-menus.pk3"` + CRLF inserted right after the call line.
- The two-line window keeps OLD from being a substring of NEW, so a second staging run does not insert the line twice (the trap documented at _refresh_fix).
- Do NOT put it in q3()'s pre list: patch_launcher() skips any launcher that already calls FLEETRES.BAT (stage-fleetres.py:1751), so it would never arrive. Do NOT hand-edit the share copy: re-staging overwrites it.
- Then re-stage with stage-fleetres.py and remove the pk3 from the library with `sharewrite.py rm`.
risks: Not yet run on hardware. The code paths it relies on are now confirmed in the staged 1.32 ui.qvm bytecode, and in ioquake3's uix86.dll: text items that show a cvar with no label (Item_Text_Paint, instruction 54289), negative list values, forward-only cycling, and the Quality presets writing r_mode. The on-screen result has only been simulated from the real font pages, not seen on a box.

The Quality presets (High/Normal/Fast/Fastest) are gone. Every individual graphics control remains. The bytecode confirms the presets wrote r_mode 4.0 or 3.0, which would have pulled the box off its own mode.
Setup > Defaults (resetDefaults: exec default.cfg, cvar_restart, vid_restart) still resets r_mode to 3 (640x480) for that session. The next launch restores it through the launcher and fleetres.cfg.
From Native, one click moves to 320x240: both UI builds cycle forward only (MOUSE1, ENTER, MOUSE2 and MOUSE3 all advance). Twelve more clicks return to Native. Nothing changes until Apply.

Cosmetic spacing, measured from the real font pages at 1920x1080. Main menu: about 9 px before the separator for a 4-digit width (15 px for a 3-digit width such as 800), 5 px after it. In game: 5 to 7 px before (13 px for a 3-digit width), 5 px after. Nothing overlaps. The tallest height ends at x 252 in game, against the frame at 261. This assumes the default ui_smallFont 0.25 and ui_bigFont 0.4.

On a pure server that does not list this pk3 (for example a Create Server host that lacks it during a mixed deployment), the stock menus return for that session: blank label, no kick. q3ta-server runs sv_pure 0.
A pk3 in a box's homepath (%APPDATA%\Quake3\missionpack, for example one auto-downloaded from a third-party server) that carries ui/system.menu would outrank this basepath pk3, whatever its name.
GAMESYNC never deletes, so withdrawing the pk3 needs the stage-fleetres.py repair pair given in launcher_changes_needed.
The Team Arena menus are mouse-driven. Checking the label is keyboard-automatable; clicking or cycling needs the cursor inside the control (see the hardware plan).
hw_verification_plan:
**Prerequisites.** Run `apply.py --publish` (not run in this phase), then GAMESYNC RESET + GAMESYNC START on the test box. Require failed_files 0, and a DIRLIST showing `<dest>\Quake3-TeamArena\missionpack\zz-fleetres-menus.pk3` at exactly 28914 bytes. `<dest>` is the dest field GAMESYNC STATUS reports (C:\Games on the LCD boxes).

**Box order.** .145 or .123 first: they run XP, where a plain SCREENSHOT 0 captures a fullscreen game. Then .240, then .195 (Windows 7, see step 5). Check PROCLIST and WINLIST first, because other agents share these boxes.

1. **Launch** with `EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Team Arena.bat"`. WINLIST must show SDL_app at 1920x1080.

2. **Main menu > SETUP > SYSTEM** (it opens on Graphics). The screenshot must show:
   - no "Quality:" row (the top slot is empty);
   - Video Mode reading "Native 1920 *1080", with a small gap before the raised asterisk (compare `.claude/evidence-1080p/build-q3-ta-menus/review/row-preview-1080p-screen.png`).

   The value must NOT be blank.

3. **In a match, ESC > System.** It must show "Native 1920 x 1080" and no Quality row. Keyboard DOWN moves focus Graphics > GL Extensions > Video Mode.

4. **Clicking (mouse-driven).**
   - The cursor must be inside the control; ENTER alone does nothing.
   - With the default DirectInput mouse, an absolute UICLICK does not move the Team Arena cursor, but a relative mouse_event does. Alternatively, as a tool only, relaunch once with `+set in_mouse -1`, which makes absolute UICLICK work (proven on .195).
   - Click once: the label must read 320*240 (320x240 in game) and the numbers must disappear. Click 12 more times: it must read Native plus the box's size again.
   - Press Apply. In the main menu this opens a confirmation popup, whose YES runs vid_restart; in game, Apply runs vid_restart directly.
   - The log must show `...setting mode -1: 1920 1080`. Get it with `+set logfile 2` or condump, then DOWNLOAD. Do not type cvar names: under ioquake3, UIKEY TEXT turns '_' into '-'.

5. **Capturing on .195.** GDI screenshots of a fullscreen game are black on Windows 7. The staged F11 bind (screenshotJPEG) works only outside menus: while a Team Arena menu is open it takes every key, and uses F11/F12 only for developer debugging. To photograph a menu, relaunch once with `+set developer 1` and press F12 inside the menu. The UI then runs `screenshot` (a TGA into %APPDATA%\Quake3\missionpack\screenshots), a path confirmed in the staged ui.qvm. DOWNLOAD it.

6. **A CRT box** if one is on (for example .124): step 2 must show that box's own mode, such as "Native 1024 *768". This proves the size is per box, not a constant.

7. **Multiplayer.**
   - Join q3ta-server at 192.168.1.132:27962 (sv_pure 0) from two boxes. ESC > System must still show Native plus the numbers.
   - There must be no pure or checksum kick, and zz-fleetres-menus.pk3 must not appear as a download. Take screenshots of both players in the match.
   - Optional: host Team Arena's own Create Server on box A (a listen server; ioquake3's default sv_pure is 1), with the pk3 on both boxes, and join from box B. Both must keep the fleet menus, with no kick.

8. **baseq3 must be unchanged.** Play Quake III Arena.bat must behave as before; the pk3 lives only in missionpack\.

9. **Cleanup.** Delete test screenshots, condumps and logfiles. Relaunch through the normal shortcut, without developer or in_mouse, and leave the box fullscreen at its proper mode.

Record the cell as verified only from fullscreen screenshots of steps 2 and 3 plus the log line from step 4.
server_installs: FUTURE, not run. `apply.py --install-server` copies ~/.retro-fleet/patch-out/q3-ta-menus/zz-fleetres-menus.pk3 into /home/voidsstr/q3ta-server/.q3a/missionpack/. That is the unit's `+set fs_homepath /home/voidsstr/q3ta-server/.q3a`, and the server's search path lists pak0-pak3 there. It writes a .tmp file, renames it into place, verifies md5 627013444d74562c7ed28ed9caa895f2, then prints `systemctl --user restart q3ta-server`. It is optional: the server runs sv_pure 0 (server.cfg) and a dedicated server loads no UI, so the file does nothing there today. It only matters if sv_pure is ever set to 1, where it keeps the fleet menus on the pure list. The pk3 holds only ui/*.menu, which never marks a pk3 as referenced, so clients are never made to download it, even with sv_allowDownload 1.
review_notes:
WHAT I VERIFIED, independently of the builder's code:
1. **Staged original.** A fresh md5sum of missionpack/pak0.pk3 gives e8ba9e3bf06210930bc0e7fdbcdd01c2 at 351623691 bytes. The two menus, extracted with unzip, have md5 ff7206507fa15d7a5be609f419d43e6a (14259 B) and 1f024f1dc61f1aa69f3044a082cef5cc (12623 B).
2. **Offsets.** My own byte search confirms every pinned value: list anchors at 2877 and 4131 (each unique), Quality blocks at 1686+417 and 2854+440 (md5s match, whole-line itemDefs), Video Mode ends at 3276 and 4534.
3. **Only the intended edits.** GNU diff shows exactly three edits per file: the 16-line Quality block becomes a 2-line comment; the list line changes; 55 lines are inserted after the Video Mode item. The committed .diff files are byte-identical to a rebuild.
4. **Only these files matter.** pak1-pak3 do not replace either menu. pak3's menus.txt loads ui/system.menu and pak0's ingame.txt loads ui/ingame_system.menu. No other Team Arena menu references r_mode or ui_glCustom.
5. **The mechanism is proven in the staged bytecode** (evidence in review/qvm-bytecode-excerpts.txt), which the builder had marked as unproven:
   - The staged ui.qvm (md5 59cb82218d1d32472851380488501feb, from pak3) was disassembled with a small QVM decoder. In Item_Text_Paint (instruction 54289), when an item has no text but has a cvar, it fetches the cvar's string (DC->getCVarString) and paints that.
   - UI_Update (function at 15101) calls trap_Cvar_SetValue("r_mode", 4.0) once and ("r_mode", 3.0) three times, so removing Quality is justified.
   - ioquake3 1.36's missionpack/uix86.dll, which is dated April 2009 and is ioquake3's own build, not id's, has the same paint branch, a PC_Float_Parse that accepts '-', and forward-only cycling. So vm_ui 0 behaves the same.
   - No stock menu uses this pattern un-wrapped: error.menu's com_errorMessage item is `autowrapped`, which is a different paint path.
6. **Layout.** The fonts are registered at 16/12/20 pt, and the scale thresholds 0.25 and 0.4 come from the QVM's cvar table. I first measured drawn extents assuming glyphs are offset by `pitch`, and got false overlaps. The ioquake3 Text_Paint disassembly shows it draws at the pen position and never reads `pitch`. With that correction, the drawn preview (review/row-preview-1080p-screen.png) shows no overlap, and the visible gaps are wider than the builder's conservative 3 px.
7. **Evidence claims checked.** The .240 condump confirms a menu click sets r_mode "1" immediately, while a console `seta r_mode -1` only latches. The underscore-to-dash typing problem is reported on four boxes.
8. **Launcher and writers.** The staged Play Team Arena.bat, FLEETRES.BAT and FLEETGL.BAT were read. %FR_ENGINE% can be the retail quake3.exe on a Voodoo 2 box, which loads the same QVM, so the fix applies there too. gameres.h:686 is correct.
9. **Server.** The q3ta-server unit and paths are right (fs_homepath ~/q3ta-server/.q3a, port 27962, sv_pure 0, sv_allowDownload 1). sharewrite.py's CLI matches the `_put` call.
10. **The parallel baseq3 builder** ships baseq3/zz-fleetres-ui.pk3 containing only vm/ui.qvm. There is no conflict: under fs_game missionpack, missionpack/pak3.pk3's ui.qvm is searched first.
11. **Hygiene.** No pk3 or extracted menu file is under git; only apply.py, two small text diffs and the test. `__pycache__/` is gitignored. Both edited files are ASCII with LF endings. Nothing is on the share (no zz pk3, no _patches/Quake3-TeamArena) or in the server's homepath. The builder's output in ~/.retro-fleet/patch-out is unchanged.

WHAT I CHANGED (all inside provisioning/patches/q3-ta-menus/ and the test file; the output bytes are unchanged):
- **apply.py cmd_publish:**
  - It refuses unless the title directory is visible through /mnt. Before, an absent mount made "no file on the share" a false negative: the backup of an existing copy was skipped, and sharewrite's put would overwrite it before its read-back failed.
  - It re-runs a quick --check and refuses if the member md5s in the manifest differ from what the staged original builds now.
  - It resolves the destination and backup paths case-insensitively (new share_abs_ci(); it replaces _share_abs).
  - A dry run now prints "dry-run: nothing was written" instead of "published."
  - main() now passes --library to publish.
- **apply.py pk3_sort_key:** it now upper-cases and maps '\\' and ':' to '/' exactly as the engine's FS_PathCmp does. The old lower-cased key reversed the order of '_' against letters. The result is the same for the current file names.
- **apply.py docstring:** records the bytecode proof, and points withdrawal at a stage-fleetres.py repair pair instead of the share copy of the .bat.
- **Tests:** 11 new (the list is in `tests`).
- **launcher_changes_needed, rewritten:**
  - The withdrawal item now names the generator and gives an idempotent repair pair. The builder's version said to edit Play Team Arena.bat, which re-staging regenerates; a pre-list edit would never reach the staged file either (patch_launcher skips launchers that already call FLEETRES).
  - The optional `+set vm_ui 2` was dropped: both UI builds behave the same, so it would be a pointless generator change.
  - The DEPLOY and SERVER items moved to the hardware plan and server_installs, since they are not launcher changes.
- **Hardware plan corrected:**
  - On .195, the F11 bind cannot capture a menu: a Team Arena menu takes every key and uses F11/F12 only for developer debugging. The plan now uses `+set developer 1` plus F12, which is present in the QVM.
  - Added the main-menu Apply confirmation popup (YES runs vid_restart), the expected spacing of the numbers, <dest> from GAMESYNC STATUS, and an optional listen-server (sv_pure 1) test.
- **Evidence:** fixed the builder's notes.txt, which gave the member sizes as 15168 and 13506; they are 15166 and 13504, the md5s were right. Added review/row-preview-1080p-screen.png, review/qvm-bytecode-excerpts.txt and review/pytest-after-review.txt.

NOT RUN, per the phase rules: --publish, --install-server, anything on a box, any service restart.
